_source: Jagatjit Agri Engineering Limited DRHP dated 25-Sep-2026 (SEBI filing 01-Oct-2026). Rs crore = Rs million / 10. Printed page = PDF page - 6. FY26 is restated CONSOLIDATED (incl. the businesses acquired from Saron Mechanical Works I and II with effect from 01-Apr-2025); FY25 and FY24 are restated STANDALONE of the pre-acquisition company and are not like-for-like with FY26. Proforma FY24-FY25 (unaudited, pp. 91-92) is used for growth and margin comparisons.

1.finding: 22:1 bonus (allotted after 30-Apr-2026 record date) and 2-for-1 split are applied retrospectively: FY26 basic EPS Rs 5.64 = Rs 313.90 m / 55,650,984 shares; NAV Rs 12.75 = Rs 709.29 m / 55,650,984. Counts are consistent across EPS, NAV and the peer table.

2.finding: FY26 operating cash flow Rs 26.85 m against PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%); cash generated from operations Rs 131.36 m before Rs 104.52 m of tax. Inventory build Rs 445.46 m and other assets Rs 281.35 m absorbed the operating profit. Cumulative reported CFO/PAT FY24-FY26 is 69.7% but mixes standalone and consolidated bases; proforma cash flows are not given.

3.finding: FY26 current tax Rs 130.30 m on PBT Rs 444.12 m (29.3%); deferred tax is a small credit (Rs 0.09 m). Cash tax paid Rs 104.52 m (23.5% of PBT). Profit is taxed largely in cash.

4.finding: Promoter-linked dealings: FY25 sales to Saron Mechanical Works II (Jagatjit Singh) Rs 209.15 m = 21.9% of standalone revenue and purchases Rs 419.46 m = 57.0% of cost of materials; businesses acquired 01-Apr-2025 for shares issued for non-cash consideration. Rs 55.0 m advances to promoters outstanding at 31-Mar-2026. Expansion capex (Rs 716.64 m) is on land leased from Jagatjit Singh (Rs 0.08 m a month, +15% every three years, p. 129).

5.finding: Fresh issue is amount-based (Rs 3,000 m gross, up to Rs 600 m of it may be raised pre-IPO), so no fixed share-count floor. Identified objects are Rs 2,001.64 m (66.7% of gross); the balance of Rs 998.36 m is offer expenses plus general corporate purposes, which are capped at 25% of gross (Rs 750 m).

6.finding: No revaluation reserve shown in the restated balance sheets.

7.finding: Goodwill Rs 4.55 m at 31-Mar-2026 against Rs 709.29 m equity (0.6%). Proforma balance sheet shows goodwill of Rs 65.66 m at 31-Mar-2025 and a capital reserve of Rs 32.98 m at 31-Mar-2024; the reconciliation of the purchase accounting between the proforma and the actual consolidation was not located in the sections read.

8.finding: Demand side: top customer Seth Agro Industries 25.21% and top 10 customers 50.04% of FY26 revenue (all dealers; no long-term agreements). Supply side is not concentrated in FY26: top supplier 7.94% and top 10 suppliers 40.53% of raw-material purchases (76.68% and 96.69% in the standalone FY25 and FY24). Punjab 25.79% and Haryana 18.48% of FY26 revenue.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 71.70 m (GST Rs 22.67 m, bank guarantees Rs 42.35 m, other Rs 6.50 m, income tax Rs 0.18 m) = 10.1% of equity of Rs 709.29 m.

R1.finding: Auditor Rule 11(g) observation in all three years: accounting software had no database-level audit trail up to 31-Dec-2025 (enabled Jan-2026). Auditor history: Singla Gupta & Co resigned 23-Apr-2024 (pre-occupation), Kansal Sandeep & Associates for FY24 only, Anup Kumar Jain & Co from 30-Sep-2024; FY24-FY25 figures are from special-purpose Ind AS statements.

R2.finding: Jagatjit Singh and Dharam Singh were disqualified as directors 29-Sep-2020 to 31-Oct-2021 (Jagatjit Agro struck off); compounding application under s.441 filed; no penalty imposed to date.

R5.finding: Mainboard issue under Regulation 6(2), not 6(1): the company does not meet Regulation 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(c) (see Eligibility, p. 503 of the DRHP).

R6.finding: Sole BRLM Keynote Financial Services: 2 issues in FY27 to date (Rs 5,858 m), both below issue price at day 30; the DRHP delegates the full track record to the BRLM website (SEBI circular CIR/MIRSD/1/2012).

R7.finding: Capex Rs 716.64 m rests on a detailed project report by L & C Techfin Advisory dated 23-Sep-2026 and is not bank-appraised; no capex has been incurred yet and deployment is FY2028.
